cases.title: Species Definition versus Character Species selection
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F004 + PPIA-05 taxonomy / species-definition and character-biological-selection
governed_facts: Reusable Species Definition remains source/version identity.
Character selection stores stable references, accepted grants, rules-profile and pack-lock evidence without editing the Definition.
acceptance: Opening a Species Definition never fabricates a current Character body or Campaign state.
Changing an authorized Character draft selection never rewrites source Species content.

cases.title: Culture and biology remain separate in ordinary Species sources
cases.source_coordinate: Humans vAlpha.PDF; Dwarves vAlpha.PDF; Elves vAlpha.PDF; PPIA-05 source inventory section 7
governed_facts: Species documents can contain physical/biological facts beside culture, philosophy, belief, adventuring and NPC material.
acceptance: Inspector labels/source-routes biological and non-biological facets separately.
Culture, philosophy, belief, profession or learned behavior never becomes immutable physiology solely because it is Species-local prose.

cases.title: Oaran mixed physiology, reproduction, habitat and culture are not flattened
cases.source_coordinate: Oaran Species.PDF; PPIA-05 source inventory section 7
governed_facts: Oaran source mixes physiological facts, reproductive/sex traits, habitat affinity, appearance and social/cultural material in one prose document.
acceptance: Projection preserves each facet's source context instead of converting the whole document into biology.
Unknown mechanical meaning is not invented from descriptive prose.

cases.title: Species Perk eligibility does not automatically prove physiology
cases.source_coordinate: Species Perks.PDF; Species Perks(1).PDF; PPIA-05 taxonomy biological-trait-ability-definition
governed_facts: Species Perks include strongly biological and clearly learned/social/generalized perks.
Species eligibility is ownership/selection context, not automatic physiology classification.
acceptance: Perk projection carries biology-ownership classification separately from Species eligibility.
A Species-gated language, tradition, social, tactical or technology-linked grant is not shown as anatomy without explicit evidence.

cases.title: Mixed Species Elementalist Innate dataset does not auto-promote biology
cases.source_coordinate: species_elementalist_and_innate_abilities_catalog.csv; PPIA-05_ABILITY_BIOLOGY_ROUTING_v0.1.0.json
governed_facts: The governed 2,203-row dataset contains 260 Species Perks, 539 Innate Abilities and 1,404 Elementalist rows.
acceptance: Dataset membership and adjacency create zero automatic Species/Form/biology ownership.
Elementalist rows remain Ability-domain content unless explicit source evidence establishes a biological relationship.

cases.title: Lineage or subspecies relationship requires explicit source evidence
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-05 taxonomy / lineage-subspecies-variant
fixture_requirements: two Species/variant candidates share a name fragment, visual trait or source document but have no explicit governed relationship evidence
acceptance: Relationship remains unresolved rather than auto-linked.
Selection/compare cannot imply parent, descendant, sibling or compatibility solely from similarity.

cases.title: Mythragara Form Definition remains distinct from current active form
cases.source_coordinate: Mythragara vAlpha2.PDF; PPIA-05 source inventory section 7; current-body-form-state
governed_facts: Mythragara source contains explicit shapeshifting mechanics, form availability, mental/sensory shifts, limitations and Form traits.
Reusable Form identity is separate from a Character currently using a form.
acceptance: Inspecting an available Form does not activate it.
Runtime form change records current state/history without altering reusable Form or Species identity.

cases.title: Shapeshifter pricing rows preserve zero automatic merges
cases.source_coordinate: Innate Trees(3).PDF; scripts/analyze-ppia01-shapeshifter-pricing.py; PPIA-05 source inventory section 6
governed_facts: There are 60 detailed Shapeshifter Ability rows and 57 pricing-only rows: Combat Forms 20/20, Environmental Adaptations 20/19, Utility Transformations 20/18.
Name similarity and tier are review hints only.
acceptance: Pricing-only and detailed records remain separately attributable unless exact source evidence or governed recommendation resolves a pairing.
No name, tier, order or similarity auto-merge is performed.

cases.title: Suula Adaptation acquisition, swapping and incompatibility remain governed state
cases.source_coordinate: Suula.PDF; PPIA-05 source inventory section 7; transformation-adaptation-state
governed_facts: Suula source contains active Adaptations, XP-purchased Adaptations, swapping, learning, incompatibilities, extremophile biology and visible markings.
acceptance: Known/acquired Adaptations remain distinct from currently active slots/state.
Swap/acquisition validates sourced limits/costs/incompatibilities and appends history instead of rewriting Species source truth.

cases.title: Environment-based learned ability is not automatically a biological Adaptation
cases.source_coordinate: Environment-Based Abilities.PDF; prestige_environment_and_special_ability_trees_catalog.csv; PPIA-05 source inventory sections 3 and 5
governed_facts: The supporting 1,018-row environment/special dataset contains 296 Environment-Based Ability Collection rows spanning social, trade, technical, exploration and learned context as well as environment-specific capability language.
acceptance: Environment linkage alone never assigns biology ownership.
Biological Adaptation requires explicit Species/Form/innate/body evidence or an owning transformation contract.

cases.title: Kola-Ha bioengineering Form is biological modification, not generic equipment
cases.source_coordinate: Kola-Ha Bioengineering.PDF; Kola-Ha vAlpha2.PDF; PPIA-05 source inventory section 7
governed_facts: Kola-Ha Bioengineering defines Forms as biological systems that can be physical, sensory, psychic or environmental and may range from temporary Adaptations to permanent symbiotic evolution.
acceptance: Inspector routes Forms through biological-modification semantics.
PPIA-03 Asset/cybernetic behavior is used only where source/rules explicitly model an Asset or installed object.

cases.title: Transformation Action commits form state and governed cost atomically
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F006/F007 Action pipeline + PPIA-05 transformation mutation invariants
acceptance: Transformation result and governed cost either both commit or neither commits.
Failed unauthorized action does not reveal hidden forms/capabilities.
Reusable Species/Form Definition remains unchanged.

cases.title: Source-unspecified anatomy does not become a human default
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-05 morphology-body-plan-anatomy and source guardrails
governed_facts: Source absence is distinct from a sourced biological fact.
acceptance: Unknown limbs, organs, lifespan, metabolism, breathing or reproduction remain unknown/source-unspecified when not sourced.
UI and validator do not silently synthesize normal-human anatomy.

cases.title: No stated incompatibility does not mean universal biological compatibility
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-05 biology-compatibility-limits
governed_facts: Compatibility requires explicit source/rule evidence.
Absence of an incompatibility rule is not proof that every Form, host, modification or Adaptation is valid.
acceptance: Unknown compatibility remains unknown and routes to the owning validation policy.
System never labels an unsupported combination compatible merely to enable a selection.

cases.title: Hidden forms and vulnerabilities do not leak through aggregates
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F020/F021 + PPIA-05 knowledge-visibility-projection
fixture_requirements: viewer may see the Character/Species but not one hidden Form, weakness or transformation trigger
acceptance: Counts, compare targets, facets, warnings, action menus, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context are computed after filtering.
Failed operations do not reveal the hidden fact's existence.

cases.title: Playable creature conversion hands into Character construction without relabeling the creature
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-02 Playable Conversion + MV-IA-F004 + PPIA-05 character-biological-selection
governed_facts: Source creature, playable species/form draft and Character instance remain separate identities.
Conversion preserves retained, normalized, excluded and unlocked provenance.
acceptance: Conversion creates/updates a governed Character/species draft rather than mutating the original creature Definition.
Linked Abilities remain references instead of copied/forked rule text.

cases.title: Temporary Effects Conditions equipment and environment do not rewrite source biology
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-05 culture_biology_separation + mutation_invariants; PPIA-03 cross-domain handoff
governed_facts: Temporary Effects, temporary Conditions, equipment and Campaign environment are non-biology facets unless a separate source-backed transformation/modification contract says otherwise.
acceptance: Current capability may change while source Species/Form facts remain stable.
Removing a temporary Effect/equipment/environmental constraint does not require source-definition repair.

cases.title: Ambiguous network transformation resolves by operation-status lookup
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F021 recovery + PPIA-05 provenance-history-recovery
fixture_requirements: client loses response after submitting idempotent transformation, Adaptation swap or bioengineering mutation
acceptance: Client queries operation ID/status before retry.
Retry reuses idempotency identity and cannot duplicate form changes, costs, Adaptation swaps, modification state or history entries.

cases.title: Accessible nonvisual Species Form selection comparison and transformation
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F022 + PPIA-05 accessibility invariants
fixture_requirements: keyboard-only and screen-reader user compares Species/Forms, reads morphology, selects an eligible Form, validates an Adaptation and completes a transformation/recovery flow
acceptance: No required step depends on color, drag, hover, animation, silhouette recognition or body-diagram pointing.
Morphology, prerequisites, active-form state, compatibility, validation and authoritative result are available as labeled text/semantics.

cases.title: Source conflict and recommendation remain visible without automatic canonical resolution
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-01 source-fact/inference/recommendation boundary + PPIA-05 provenance-history-recovery
governed_facts: Source fact, source absence, inference/recommendation and conflict remain distinguishable.
Same-name/tier/similarity evidence may aid review but does not create canonical identity or mechanics.
acceptance: Inspector exposes authorized source coordinates and conflict/recommendation status without silently choosing a winner.
Governance proposal remains reversible/attributable and does not mutate raw PDF/CSV source.
